chapter: Chapter 8 — The Grave of Henry Avery (Scotland)
title: Cathedral Crosses — Orion Beam Puzzle
steps_en: Examine the three crosses at the front of the cathedral to add the mandatory journal entry, then talk to Sam about Avery's obsession with Saint Dismas.
Circle around the BACK of the crosses and examine the lamp; ask Sam to light it — the mechanisms behind the wall light up.
Return to the front. Each cross has a portal below it; use the left/right analog sticks to rotate and slide each light beam so it points at stars on the wall.
Goal: the three beams together must draw the constellation ORION on the wall.
DISMAS (left cross): aim its beam at the second star from the bottom AND the top-right star.
JESUS (middle cross): aim its beam at the TOP star and the BOTTOM star.
GETAS (right cross): aim its beam at the final two stars (the remaining lower stars of Orion's belt area).
When every star is covered and Orion is complete, the puzzle resolves — read the journal, then continue to Avery's grave.

chapter: Chapter 8 — The Grave of Henry Avery (Scotland)
title: Avery's Grave Star Door
steps_en: Inspect the locked door marked with the star pattern next to Avery's grave — Nate sketches it in the journal.
Turn around and examine the lamp behind you; have Sam light it so the mechanism glows.
Behind the wall panel, rotate and move the emitted lights with the analog sticks to recreate the exact star pattern you saw on the door.
There is exactly ONE solution — match each light to a door star; wrong overlap positions simply don't click, so keep rotating until each light locks onto a star.

title: Nornir Chest Rune Seals
steps_en: Find the sealed golden chest, then locate its three rune seals nearby — they are never inside the chest room itself.
Seal types: rune bells (hit with the axe — they re-ring, so hit all three quickly), rune switches (throw the axe to lock them), and rune idols (destroy the green growth with the blades first).
Hit/lock all three seals in quick succession; the chest unlocks and grants an Idunn Apple (health) or Horn of Blood Mead (rage).

title: Grand Lift of Dectus — Two Medallion Halves
steps_en: The Grand Lift of Dectus needs BOTH medallion halves; the lift tells you the right half is missing if you only hold one.
Left half: at Fort Haight (east Limgrave) — climb the keep, open the chest at the top of the tower.
Right half: at Fort Faroth (east Caelid, across the limgrave border) — chest at the top of the battlements.
With both halves, stand on the lift plinth and raise it — it carries you to the Altus Plateau.
